verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًا
verses.translation: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
And the winds that blow violently
And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
And those [angels] who bring criterion[1816]
And those [angels] who deliver a message
As justification or warning,
Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.translation: So when the stars are obliterated

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the heaven is opened

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the mountains are blown away

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the messengers' time has come...[1817]
verses.footnotes: [1817]- i.e., when they are gathered to witness concerning their nations. The sentence's conclusion is understood to be "...the promised judgement will then take place."

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: For what Day was it postponed?[1818]
verses.footnotes: [1818]- "It" may refer to either the aforementioned occurrences collectively or to the testimony of the messengers.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: For the Day of Judgement.
And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
Woe,[1819] that Day, to the deniers.
Did We not destroy the former peoples?
Then We will follow them with the later ones.
Thus do We deal with the criminals.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]
For a known extent.
And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Have We not made the earth a container
Of the living and the dead?

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
verses.translation: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

verses.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍ
verses.translation: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns

verses.arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
verses.translation: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.translation: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
This is a Day they will not speak,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
And fruits from whatever they desire,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translation: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
[O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
verses.translation: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
